messages:
Jordan (Sales): FYI incoming request from Finlytics — they want us to pin and serve `mistral-large-1-v2` with EU data residency + APAC availability. Customer asks: version pin, custom 4-bit quant build for latency, KMS integration, and SLA. Target: launch in ~6 weeks. They’re open to Dedicated commit. Case #FC-8721.
Maria (PM): thanks. can you paste their exact asks and any contractual timeline? also what accuracy vs latency tradeoffs did they mention? @Aj for feasibility.
Jordan (Sales): pasted excerpt they sent:
```
Model: mistral-large-1-v2
Regions: eu-west-1 (required), ap-southeast-1 (preferred)
Pin: exact model version (no rolling updates)
Quant: customer-supplied 4-bit quant artifact or vendor-provided quant
SLO: p95 latency <= 250ms @ 128 tokens OR equivalent cost SLA
Data: EU-only, must use customer KMS
Timeline: 6 weeks preferred, willing to sign Dedicated commit
```
Maria (PM): clear. @Aj can we meet the latency/SLO goals with a 4-bit quant? what infra + catalog work needed?
Aj (Eng): quick take — kernel support for Mistral + 4-bit quant is spotty across runtimes. we'll need benchmarking on our inference runtime and possibly a new kernel path. rough split: benchmarking (2w), runtime changes/quant kernel (3w), deployment/config for pinned model + regions (2w), QA/legal/compliance (1w). naive sum = 8w. if we parallelize and get a dedicated eng pair we can aim for 6w.
Aj (Eng): also think about fallback: if 13B quantized perf/regressions are bad, we should offer a pre-approved fallback (e.g., `mistral-7b-quant-v1`) to keep the integration usable.
Sam (Support): added context — Finlytics wants SOC2 proof and KMS integration details up front. They also asked about audit logs for every inference. I shared our standard compliance pack but legal wants to review before we commit to timeline.
Eva (SRE): capacity note — eu-west GPU reservations are tight next month. If they go Dedicated we can reserve, but Hosted availability may require queued deployment. APAC will add ops overhead (network egress + local partners).
Jordan (Sales): customer insists on 13B model for accuracy. they said "we'll accept up to ~10% higher latency if it keeps quality, but p95 must be <=250ms for 128 tokens". they can sign a 12-month Dedicated commit to secure capacity.
Maria (PM): proposed acceptance criteria (suggested):
- Catalog entry with pinned `mistral-large-1-v2` artifact and checksum present in our model registry
- Perf: p95 <= 250ms @ 128 tokens on eu-west dedicated pool (measured with our perf harness)
- Quality: no more than 3% drop vs unquantized baseline on customer eval set
- Security: KMS integration validated, audit logs enabled, SOC2 artifacts attached
- Rollout: staged: EU -> APAC (gated by perf + SRE signoff)
If we agree, I can scope JIRA ticket and priority.
Aj (Eng): those criteria look reasonable. couple clarifications: 1) "customer eval set" — need to confirm size and access method (they must provide or sign NDA for sample prompts). 2) kernel fallback policy: we should document automatic fallback to 7B quant in policy if perf/regression fails in prod.
Jordan (Sales): will confirm eval set + push legal NDA this afternoon. they want weekly check-ins.
triage-bot: INF-3921 created and added to product backlog: "Finlytics — mistral-large-1-v2 pin + EU/APAC availability" (assignee: unassigned). Link: https://redwood.internal/INF-3921
Maria (PM): next steps: 1) @Aj please do a quick spike this week (2-3 days) to validate 4-bit quant perf on one eu-west instance. 2) @Sam confirm what compliance artifacts legal needs. 3) @Eva estimate Dedicated reservation lead time if customer signs commit. I'll schedule a 30m sync with Jordan + Finlytics for Thurs.
Aj (Eng): starting spike today, will post results in this thread by EOD Friday.
Sam (Support): noted — I’ll collect SOC2 snippets and KMS doc and drop into INF-3921 by EOD tomorrow.
Eva (SRE): will check reservation timelines and give options (fast-reserve via Dedicated vs standard hosted slot) in INF-3921 by EOD.
Maria (PM): thanks all — keeping this as P1 backlog candidate given revenue + Dedicated signal. We'll reconvene after the spike. :white_check_mark:
